title: FSU W5 element-oracle meta (fsu-oracle-v1)
description: Pre-registered meta for one PolyBench output-array dump. The tolerance triple (abs_tol/rel_tol/ulp_tol) is mandatory and MUST be fixed before the fault run; tools/fsu_oracle.py never infers it from results. Arrays are canonical raw fp32, row-major, explicitly little-endian, count*4 bytes. domain=full requires count==shape[0]*shape[1]; domain=lower_triangle_incl_diag requires a square shape and count==n*(n+1)/2.

fnv1a.description: Optional pre-registered FNV-1a 64 of the canonical bytes; verified by tools/fsu_oracle.py load_array.
